recommendation: Keep the external-repo audit for core. If OO wants to reconcile SupplyRequest's external wording with the later deliverFor semantics, do that in HL7/oo-incubator rather than in inactive core SupplyRequest files.
issue_request: FHIR-27941 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and asked OO to clarify that DeviceRequest is used for requesting a device for clinical use by or for a particular patient, while SupplyRequest is for inventory/logistics use, with Medication also allowed as a SupplyRequest item for floor-stock replenishment.
initial_application: No commit explicitly tagged FHIR-27941 was found. Related commit 578361a9000ef12bb67e86de2e5fb27ea52bd79a applied FHIR-24936 boundary text to DeviceRequest and SupplyRequest. Later source history added the current SupplyRequest logistics wording, FHIR-39066 removed the ballot question about combining SupplyRequest and DeviceRequest, and FHIR-39511 added SupplyRequest.deliverFor.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini no longer has an active supplyrequest=SupplyRequest entry; commit 3b38b80cf23f9cbb306fab8fcedb293315478c32 removed SupplyRequest and related OO resources from the core resource list and current core links point to the HL7 OO Incubator IG. The external OO Incubator SupplyRequest JSON remains the live SupplyRequest surface. Related FHIR-39066 and FHIR-39511 are already represented on the combined branch, so no duplicate commits were published for them.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. Editing source/supplyrequest in this checkout would affect an out-of-build copy, while active DeviceRequest text already states that DeviceRequest concerns device use/allocation for a patient. Any remaining SupplyRequest narrative cleanup belongs in the external OO Incubator source.
